file_roles.evidence: registerBaseTableRef/registerInlineViewRef replaced by registerTableRef registering the unqualified implicit alias plus ambiguousAliases_; registerColumnRef/getDescriptor rewritten to resolve via these aliases.
name_/getAlias()/getAliasAsName() moved up to TableRef and createTupleDescriptor added; restructuring to feed the shared registerTableRef.
Constructor now takes TableName, createTupleDescriptor takes Analyzer, adds createDummyTable(); adaptation to the new registration path.
expandStar error message changed from 'unknown table: X' to 'unknown table alias 'X''; diagnostic change at the site that reported the failure.
Hosts name_, hasExplicitAlias(), getAlias(), getAliasAsName() moved from subclasses; supporting state for the Analyzer change.
Adds hasExplicitAlias_ and setAlias(alias, isExplicit); supporting state used by Analyzer.

ViewRef constructors passed origTblRef.getAlias() (full name) as an explicit alias and no TableName; diff passes name_ and alias_ separately and overrides createDummyTable, so views get implicit aliases.
Adds InlineView(Table) constructor used by ViewRef.createDummyTable; plumbing.

rationale: The reported errors 'unknown table: alltypes' and 'unknown table alias' come from alias lookup when only the unqualified name is used with a star or a view. Analyzer is rewritten to register and resolve implicit aliases, and ViewRef stops treating the view name as an explicit alias. The other files carry the supporting restructuring.
notes: ViewRef labelled causal because its old constructors lost the implicit-alias information for views (the second half of the report); other supporting files are refactor.
